name: Google Jules MCP
description: An MCP server for automating Google Jules that enables seamless integration for task creation, code analysis, and AI-powered development workflows. It supports multiple session modes including Browserbase and cookie-based authentication for both local and cloud environments.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server for automating Google Jules that enables seamless integration for task creation, code analysis, and AI-powered development workflows. It supports multiple session modes including Browserbase and cookie-based authentication for both local and cloud environments.

SESSION_MODE.description: Session management mode to use. Options: fresh, chrome-profile, cookies, persistent, browserbase.

JULES_DATA_PATH.description: Custom data storage path for task data and history.

BROWSERBASE_API_KEY.description: API key for Browserbase, required if SESSION_MODE is 'browserbase'.

GOOGLE_AUTH_COOKIES.description: Google authentication cookies string, required if SESSION_MODE is 'cookies'.

CHROME_USER_DATA_DIR.description: Path to Chrome user data directory, required if SESSION_MODE is 'chrome-profile' or 'persistent'.

BROWSERBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Project ID for Browserbase, required if SESSION_MODE is 'browserbase'.

BROWSERBASE_SESSION_ID.description: Optional existing Browserbase session ID to reuse.

rawRecord.name: Google Jules MCP
